findings.title: Repository-relative check does not contain real parent symlinks
findings.observed: The lexical candidate check and lstat reject an absolute path, traversal, or a symlinked body, but realpath is compared only with the Master Library. A temporary repository with reference/utah as a symlink to an outside directory and the exact 128760-byte PDF was accepted by resolveCommittedKnownResidualBinding.
findings.impact: A path that is lexically below the repository can resolve to arbitrary external custody and still inherit the exact admission. This contradicts the helper comment that a symlink is refused and permits source-location substitution outside the verified repository namespace.
findings.requiredFix: Resolve the repository root itself and require the candidate realpath to equal or descend from that real root before accepting it; retain the explicit Master Library exclusion. Add a hermetic test with a symlinked parent directory, and assert refusal.

findings.title: Conflicting custody-row path is not refused
findings.observed: When an existing row carries sourceId official-form:1174XX, familySources suppresses the admitted source because the source ID is present, without comparing the row path or digest to the exact admission. A hermetic row pointing to reference/utah/wrong-name.pdf containing the same expected bytes returned that wrong path as the family source.
findings.impact: The implementation comment promises that a conflicting row binding still fails, but a same-byte different-path binding can pass the downstream hash check. The exact admission therefore does not control the source path, and a conflicting custody row can substitute its identity.
findings.requiredFix: For this scoped family, reject a pre-existing source row with the expected raw/obligation source ID unless its path, SHA-256, and declared length match the admission exactly; represent the conflict in unresolvable so family_sources_bind fails. Add a negative test using a different path with the expected bytes.

findings.title: Existing MO negative test is stale in the recovered corpus
findings.observed: The unchanged test hardcodes mo-610-140-arrest-set, mo-610-140-conviction-set, and mo-610-145-mistaken-identity-set as DOES_NOT_BIND. In the current recovered corpus, mo-610-140-arrest-set and mo-610-140-conviction-set actually bind; the full file reports 9 passed and 1 failed on the first assertion.
findings.impact: The focused test file is not green, although this result is unrelated to the UT-only admission bridge. Treating it as a passing regression would conceal an environment-dependent assertion.
findings.requiredFix: Make the negative case hermetic or narrow the assertion to a source that is demonstrably absent in a fixture. Preserve the missing/corrupt-body refusal; do not weaken it and do not turn the test into a queue-pin-only check.
findings.implementationCausality: No UT patch branch changes MO resolution: the special admission is exact-family scoped, and the existing MO expectation predates the current recovered bytes.
